card.name: Cardiac risk wording in diabetes trials
card.fires_on: Words inside cardiovascular-risk phrases in diabetes and lipid drug labels, such as 'coronary' in 'acute coronary syndrome', or 'ous' in 'Heterozygous'. It also fires on a few odd spots like a percent sign in demographics.

modes.label: Acute coronary syndrome phrase
modes.description: Words in the phrase describing trial patients with recent acute coronary syndrome or cardiovascular disease.
